svg.title: Spatial tokens, logical work, and packed word destinations — repack_2d_to_1d_c1024_fp16
svg.desc: Direction-specific token-to-byte permutation with one grid-stride work item and individual low-bit coordinates.
svg.text: Spatial tokens, logical work, and packed word destinations
spatial tiles → one uint32 register → token sequence + zero tail
Grid: token low 4 bits × channel-word low 3 bits.
Cell values are logical coordinates, not physical offsets.
Grid: token low 4 bits × channel-word low 3 bits.
Cell values are logical coordinates, not physical offsets.
W=60: token 309 = pixel (9,5) → spatial token 277. 512 uint32 words per token.
Logical i=158,221; first pass block=618, thread=13, warp=0, lane=13. Smaller grids repeat at gridDim.x×256.
Inner physical permutation: [t2 t1 t0 c1 c0 c2 t3] = 1010110₂ = 86 words for this example.
Forward alignment = 16 tokens; padded tokens write zero without a source load.
No shared transpose, conversion or Tensor Core operation: the optimized operation is this exact bit-preserving permutation.
